name: cljd-resolve
description: Hover docs and jump-to-definition for Flutter symbols in .cljd files.

cljd-resolve.daemonPath.markdownDescription: Path to `bin/cljd-resolve`. Empty means: look next to the extension, then in the repo above it, then on `PATH`.

cljd-resolve.extraPath.markdownDescription: Directories prepended to `PATH` when spawning the daemon. Use this when VSCode cannot find `bb` — a GUI launch inherits a much barer `PATH` than a terminal does.

cljd-resolve.requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for one resolve before giving up.

cljd-resolve.warmUp.description: Start the Dart analyzer when a .cljd file opens, so the first hover does not pay its ~8s startup.

cljd-resolve.trace.description: Log every request and result to the ClojureDart Resolve output channel.
